Convert UV-C parameters to equivalent ACH (eACH)

Source: R/interventions.R
uv_to_delta.Rd

Converts a UV-C intervention's photophysical parameters into an equivalent air-change rate (eACH) that can be used as a delta in the Wells-Riley framework. The conversion is delta = f * E_avg * k * 3.6. The factor 3.6 assumes E_avg is in µW/cm^2 and k is in cm^2/mJ: it combines the µW to mW conversion (1e-3) with the per-second to per-hour conversion (3600). Supplying E_avg in mW/cm^2 would overstate eACH by a factor of 1000.

Usage

uv_to_delta(f, E_avg, k)

Arguments

f

Fraction of the room volume that is irradiated (dimensionless, in [0, 1]).

E_avg

Average fluence rate within the irradiated volume (µW/cm^2).

k

UV inactivation (susceptibility) constant for the target pathogen (cm^2/mJ).

Value

Equivalent ACH contribution from UV-C (units: 1/hour).

See also
